574:t_1:84.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No matter how much debt I end up with, I've got reasons to go home...」

574:t_1:85.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Like I said... there's no point trying to look cool when it's about debt.」

574:t_1:86.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And in his case... paying back his debt is one of the reasons he has to return.」

574:t_1:87.en:
$$五飛$$
「So it all comes back to that.」

574:t_1:88.en:
$n
「This complete lack of wavering is the $$揺れる天秤$$...」

574:t_1:89.en:
$$フェルト$$
「All $c personnel. We've confirmed a distortion in the dimensional boundary 50 kilometers east of here.」

574:t_1:90.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So that's where $$トレミー$$ jumped in.」

574:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$マルグリット$$ told me about it once... That's where the $$破界の王$$ first appeared in $$インサラウム$$.」

574:t_1:96.en:
$$赤木$$
「So $$ガイオウ$$ is coming after all...!」

574:t_1:98.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...We've got no choice but to go.」

574:t_2:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you've damn well shown up...」

574:t_2:4.en:
???
「...It seems they were trying to lure me into this world.」

574:t_2:5.en:
???
「I may be a defeated commander, but if they thought they could control me with mere $$イドム$$, they were dead wrong.」

574:t_2:8.en:
???
「It has a nice ring to it, but I have the name my parents gave me, and the name $$次元将$$ $$ヴァイシュラバ$$.」

574:t_2:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Are you planning to turn us into $$次元獣$$s?」

574:t_2:12.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「You're not just fighting them. You even know about $$次元獣$$s...」

574:t_2:13.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「It seems you're my comrades.」

574:t_2:15.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「...I thought I'd rebuild my army in this world, but with people like you around, it seems there's no part for me to play.」

574:t_2:16.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「I'll go to some other world.」

574:t_2:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are you going to turn people into $$次元獣$$s there!?」

574:t_2:20.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「After seeing people like you, even I have to change my thinking.」

574:t_2:21.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「I won't beat them unless I find warriors who can grow without limit, instead of turning them into $$次元獣$$s and capping their strength there.」

574:t_2:22.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「That's how it is, brothers. If we meet in the Heavenly Prison, let's fight together.」

575:t_000:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Give me... a situation report...!」

575:t_000:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We've detected all $c ships and units in the area. All units are intact.」

575:t_000:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So everyone who was there got sent to Earth.」

575:t_000:5.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「For now, I'm praying it's not some other planet.」

575:t_000:6.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Judging by the terrain, our current location is...」

575:t_000:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I've spotted a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ to the southeast!」

575:t_001:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But it's smaller than the ones we know.」

575:t_001:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I've detected units launching from the facilities around the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$!」

575:t_002:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Are those $$アークセイバー$$s!?」

575:t_002:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「So they... were on Earth.」

575:t_002:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「But why are they piloting $$ディム・サー$$s? They're supposed to be part of the $$連邦軍$$, too...」

575:t_002:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, I'll find out what's going on. Open a communications channel.」

575:t_002:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「This is $$スメラギ・李・ノリエガ$$ of $c. $$アークセイバー$$s, please respond.」

575:t_002:7.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Don't tell me they... investigated $$インサラウム$$ in advance!」

575:t_002:9.en:
$$フェルト$$
「They... may not know that $c has been formed.」

575:t_002:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We're former members of 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》. Some trouble sent us here, but...」

575:t_002:11.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「So you are visitors brought here by that $$時空震動$$ earlier!」

575:t_002:13.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「No, you won't fool us! If it was an accident, why do you know who we are!?」

575:t_002:14.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「These people... are invaders from a parallel world, targeting the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$!」

575:t_002:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You're saying this is 《$$インサラウム$$》...!」

575:t_002:18.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「But Earth in that world was supposed to have been destroyed when $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ went out of control!」

575:t_003:0.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「$$インサラウム$$ will be destroyed!?」

575:t_003:1.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We won't let that happen! All units, begin your attack!」

575:t_003:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What do we do, $$スメラギ$$!?」

575:t_003:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...We can't negotiate in this situation. Fall back so we can meet up with the others!」

575:t_003:4.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「I'm activating $$トランザム$$! Keep up, $$クロウ$$!」

575:t_004:1.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Put the area on alert and contact the holy capital immediately! We may have to request deployment of the $$ハイナイト$$s!」

575:t_006:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's those pitch-black bastards we saw in that strange space!」

575:t_006:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「And there are so many of them...!」

575:t_006:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「They took out the $$アークセイバー$$s!」
